o.text: From *kēbere-, from Proto-Turkic *kebe- (“to swell”). Cognate with Chuvash каврай (kavraj).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *bilegü (as reflected in Ottoman Turkish بیلکی (bileği)), from *bi-le- (“to hoon, to sharpen”), from *bī/*bï̄ (“blade”).
